title: A derived arrow presenting a strict degree-two Ext class
statement: In any abelian category A with Ext and a chosen derived category, for xi:Ext²(S,H), derived objects K,J, isomorphisms a:K≅single(S), b:J≅single(H)[2], and f:K→J, ExtArrowPresentation(xi,a,b,f) means xi.hom=a.inverse≫f≫b.hom. This is precisely the existing Ext.hom presentation equation, with its category structures shared explicitly.

def ExtArrowPresentation
    {A : Type*} [Category A] [Abelian A] [HasExt A] [HasDerivedCategory A]
    {S H : A} (xi : Ext S H 2) {K J : DerivedCategory A}
    (a : K ≅ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor A 0).obj S)
    (b : J ≅ ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor A 0).obj H)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)
    (f : K ⟶ J) : Prop
